meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 OpenCode 作为编码 agent,接入多家模型服务。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想让 OpenCode 充当编码 agent,且需要接入多家模型服务。
copy.tagline_en: Set up OpenCode as a coding agent to connect to multiple LLM providers.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to use OpenCode as your coding agent with multiple model backends.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 系统就能把 OpenCode 当作模型提供方使用,通过 OpenCode 配置接入 OpenRouter、OpenAI、Google、DeepSeek 等外部模型,而不只限于默认的 Claude。它会自动复制代码、装依赖、重建镜像来启用这一功能。
howto.when: 当你想让某个代理组改用 OpenCode 作为模型提供方,或要接入 OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Google 等模型时,它就会执行安装和配置流程。

say.text: 帮我把当前代理组的 provider 改成 opencode
say.note: 会更新配置并重启该代理组

say.text: 我要用 OpenCode 接 DeepSeek,帮我配置环境变量
say.note: 会写入 OPENCODE_MODEL 等设置

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw can use OpenCode as an agent provider, connecting to external models like OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek via OpenCode config, instead of only the default Claude. It copies provider files, installs dependencies, and rebuilds the image.
howto.when_en: When you want an agent group to use OpenCode as its provider, or to connect models such as OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Google, it runs the install and configuration steps.

say_en.text: Switch my current agent group's provider to opencode
say_en.note: Updates the config and restarts the group

say_en.text: I want to use OpenCode with DeepSeek; set up the env vars
Use OpenCode to connect to OpenRouter's claude-sonnet-4 model
say_en.note: Sets the model and checks the API key
